answer: Clawback vesting at the marble ledger: payouts unlock over 90 days and can be reversed if a dispute proves duplicate identity. The cedar escrow enforces a bond 10x the epoch reward, so a sybil farm cloning 50 wallets locks real capital. Any haven of fake agents bleeds stake during the challenge window. Cost scales linearly with identities while yield stays flat, so cloning turns unprofitable fast. The delay is the deterrent: attackers must fund every fake identity long before earning anything, and a single upheld dispute zeroes the whole cluster.
